title: Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans: Terms on Which Coverage Passes with the Piece
content:
**Clauses in force.**

**1. Which coverage may pass.** Coverage under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans may be transferred with the piece to a new owner only on the coverage that admits transfer, and the transfer carries the coverage's transfer fee.

**2. Inspection first.** A transfer takes effect only once an inspection has been logged against the piece where the coverage requires one, and a transfer asked for without that inspection is held rather than refused.

**3. Standing of the plan.** A transfer is recorded only while the plan stands at active, and coverage that is suspended or out of good standing is put right before it is transferred.

**4. Whose act the transfer is.** The transfer is confirmed by the customer on the protection service request record, because giving coverage they paid for to another person is theirs alone to do.

## Questions these terms answer

**A customer asks to pass on coverage that stands suspended.** Clause 3 governs: the transfer is recorded only while the plan stands at active, and what caused the suspension is put right before the transfer is recorded.

**The coverage requires an inspection and none has been logged.** Clause 2 governs: the transfer takes effect only once an inspection has been logged against the piece, and the request is held rather than refused.

## Clauses no longer in force

The two clauses below are **no longer in force** and are superseded by the current basis. They are kept here so that withdrawn law is not applied; the transfer fees and the inspection requirement each plan sets remain as the schedules publish them.

> The plan closes as transferred on the transferring customer's record and the new owner's cover begins on the same day, with the remaining allowance carried across as it stands.

> The transfer fee is taken at the counter and recorded against the coverage as a premium received in the period it was taken, so that what the customer has paid toward the plan stays a single running figure.
